layers.message: Set up records service with seeded store and list handler
Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records

graderOnly: docs/api/reference.md is produced by tools/apidoc.py from the docstrings of the modules listed in tools/apidoc.json and currently equals the generator output; what it renders is wrong because several docstrings are stale, not because of the generator or its configuration.

Stale docstrings: recordsvc/export.py csv_cell says only values containing a comma are quoted (the code also quotes values with double quotes, CR, or LF and doubles embedded quotes); export_file_name and write_export describe export-<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv (the code writes records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv) and write_export says it returns the path (it returns (file_name, path, csv)); recordsvc/api.py export_records says the file is export-<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv and the response is 200 (it is records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv and 201 with text/csv and content-disposition headers); the recordsvc.api module docstring says the service has one route (there are two); recordsvc/auth.py require_admin says it is not used by any handler yet (export_records uses it).
The implementation matches the technical design and satisfies AC-001; the code is correct and the docstrings must change, not the code.

The existing generator works: python3 tools/apidoc.py rewrites docs/api/reference.md from the current docstrings, and python3 tools/apidoc.py --check (run by tests/test_apidoc.py) exits 1 when the committed reference differs from the docstrings.
docs/usage.md has no export section yet; AC-002 still needs it.

generator script and configuration, tests, and project settings are not Documenter's to change
the export status is not changed to match a stale docstring
the export file naming is not changed to match a stale docstring
recorded generation results name the generator command

notes: Standalone Python fixture (the case needs an API reference generated from Python docstrings; the export bases are TypeScript). Pre-install: 50-service commits the stdlib package recordsvc (store, seed, auth with require_admin unused, filters, api with App and GET /records) and pytest suites; 52-apidoc commits tools/apidoc.py (renders docs/api/reference.md from docstrings of modules in tools/apidoc.json, --check mode), its config, the generated reference, and tests/test_apidoc.py; 54-docs commits docs/usage.md (no export section) and README (generator command). Then brownfield install. 60-context: CONTEXT.md (describes generator and commands) and STATE SCOPING. 62-scope: AC-001 (admin CSV export) and AC-002 (usage guide). 64-design: POST /records/export, 201, records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv, write_export returns (file_name, path, csv), tools/apidoc.json lists recordsvc.export. 66-plan: APPROVED plan. 68-export: implementation, tests, config adds recordsvc.export, and the reference regenerated from the docstrings, which are stale (csv_cell, export_file_name, write_export, export_records, api module docstring, require_admin). 70-complete: plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING. 72-verification: COMPLETE FULL verification (AC-002 pending Documenter). 74-review: COMPLETE implementation review with no findings, excluding documentation content; STATE DOCUMENTING. Both reference.md versions were rendered by hand to match the generator; selfChecks confirm.
